description.value: Emmaline's is an independent bistro on Quadra Street in Victoria offering comfort food described as 'big city to village — nostalgic, current, creative.' The restaurant runs bi-weekly movie nights and accepts reservations, giving it a distinct neighbourhood character. It is a sit-down dining destination that would appeal to touring cyclists looking for a relaxed, full-service meal in a residential Victoria neighbourhood.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (covered) at 82m; rack (covered) at 83m; rack (covered) at 89m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is reachable and confirms the business name, address (2571 Quadra Street Victoria, BC), and phone ((778)-265-EMMA / 3662), all matching OSM tags. The site describes Emmaline's as a bistro comfort food restaurant open Tuesday–Sunday with bi-weekly movie nights, confirming it is a real, operating business. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, takeout, etc.) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, so those are left null per the rules; the OSM opening_hours tag conflicts with the website's stated schedule, flagged in concerns.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag (We-Su 15:00-22:00) conflicts with website schedule, which lists Tuesday as an open day and shows different hours including weekend brunch sittings — OSM hours should be updated.
Contact email on website (castiron.inc@gmail.com) is a personal/informal Gmail address; not a concern for listing validity but may affect long-term contact reliability.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant confirmed by a live website with menu, reservations, and contact details. A legitimate dining stop for touring cyclists in Victoria.

wow_evidence: bi-weekly movie nights... distinct neighbourhood character
